issues.concern: The English translation 'There are so many people!' for 'すごい人がたくさんいますね。' misrepresents the Japanese. While 'すごい' can mean 'so many' in some contexts, here it implies 'amazing/incredible people' or 'a lot of amazing people', not just a large quantity.
issues.suggestion: Change the English translation to 'There are so many amazing people!' or 'There are so many incredible people!'
